columns.name: survey_id
columns.description: The unique identifier of the survey.

columns.name: num_people_mental_illness
columns.description: The number of people in the survey who was identified with mental illness (who responded ‘Yes’ to Question 34), replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_questions_more_than_200_answers
columns.description: The number of questions in the survey that received more than 200 answers, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: oldest_user_age
columns.description: The age of the oldest user who answered the survey (question 'What is your age?')

columns.name: per_bring_mental_issue_in_interview
columns.description: The percentage of people in the survey who would bring up a mental health issue with a potential employer in an interview. Only include respondents who answered that question.

columns.name: contains_work_city
columns.description: Set to 1 if the survey contains the question "What country do you work in?", 0 otherwise.
